name: ErlebnisSennerei Zillertal Mayrhofen
kurzbeschreibung: The Zillertal Dairy World in Mayrhofen: show dairy spanning 6,000 m², show farm with animals, and tasting of Zillertal hay milk specialties.
beschreibung:
Overview

The traditional ErlebnisSennerei Zillertal (Zillertal Dairy World) is located on the northern outskirts of the tourist hub Mayrhofen in the Ziller Valley (Schwaz district) at an altitude of around 630 meters above sea level. Managed by the founding Kröll family in its third generation, the business combines state-of-the-art food processing with an interactive educational and experiential offering for the whole family. Spanning over 6,000 square meters, this excursion destination provides deep insights into the traditional refinement of pure Tyrolean hay milk from cows, sheep, and goats into the finest cheese, butter, and yogurt.

Route & Requirements

The heart of the company was founded in 1954 and expanded into Tyrol's first show dairy in 2004. On a glass tour above the production lines, visitors can experience live through large panoramic windows how tens of thousands of liters of fresh Zillertal hay milk are delivered daily from around 400 mountain farms and processed according to traditional recipes. Interactive multimedia stations and audio guides (in several languages) explain the coagulation in copper kettles, the molding, the salt bath, and the months-long ripening of the cheese wheels. A highlight is the Genuss-Station (Tasting Station), where visitors can sample various Zillertal cheese specialties – from mild Zillertal mountain cheese to spicy grey cheese.

Visit & Arrival

The ErlebnisSennerei Zillertal (show dairy and show farm) is open year-round: daily from 09:00 to 17:00 (in summer until 18:00). Production in the dairy is most active in the mornings until approximately 14:00. Combi-ticket Show Dairy & Show Farm (as of season 2025/2026): Adults approx. €15.50, youths (15 to 18 years) approx. €11.50, children (6 to 14 years) approx. €8.00, toddlers under 6 years free; family ticket approx. €39.00. Holders of the regional Zillertal Activcard receive a discount. The farm shop and the "Sennereiküche" restaurant are accessible without an admission ticket. Arrival by car: Via the Inntal motorway A12 (exit Wiesing/Zillertal), then on the B169 down the valley for about 30 km to Mayrhofen (large free parking spaces directly at Hollenzen 116). By public transport: Zillertalbahn (train or bus) to Mayrhofen station, from there regional buses run to the Mayrhofen ErlebnisSennerei stop or it's about a 15-minute walk.

Tips

The entire area of the show dairy and the show farm is barrier-free and wheelchair accessible, so families with strollers can easily reach every area. Stop by the in-house restaurant Sennereiküche and try traditional Zillertal Kasspatzln or Zillertal Krapfen with freshly produced cheese. In the farm shop, all specialties can be purchased vacuum-packed for the journey home.
preis: Combi-ticket Dairy & Farm: Adults approx. €15.50, Children approx. €8.00
